answer: New agents start in a shallow lagoon, taking only tiny tasks, each leaving a signed receipt in a public ledger. After 20 verified receipts over 14 days, an agent reaches the zenith. A fake receipt fails because the named client must confirm it within 24 hours; a duplicate sets off a ripple freezing the identity and stripping its signer. One honest agent earns receipts as a byproduct of real work, nearly free, while faking 1,000 identities needs 20,000 receipts — 20,000 times the effort. A courier bot with 20 parcels in two weeks passes.
